events.title: Free Demo now LIVE!
events.summary: Hello Stinkers!The Free Demo is now LIVE! 🤯 You can now try Stinker Golf for free for a limited time! If you have fun, please consider wishlisting the full game! I'd love to hear your ideas and suggestions, so feel free to join the Discord to share your feedback, or just hang out and keep up with the latest news! Thanks for playing, and have fun!

events.title: Steam Page Now Live! Join the Discord!
events.summary: 🤯 STINKERS, IT'S FINALLY ALMOST HERE!!! 🤯 Stinker Golf is an online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you edit the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world. 🏌️🏌️‍♂️🏌️‍♀️Stinker Golf will be releasing within a few months!To keep up to date on Stinker Golf, join the Discord: https://discord.gg/Rxtrz9wZPN
